Aisha (CSM): quick weekly pulse on BridgePay — token flow + throughput for the last 7 days. sharing topline before the customer call tomorrow.
Tom (Data Eng): tokens WoW +18%, QoQ +47%. avg daily tokens = 2.9M -> spike day to 4.1M on Tue (ingest job change).
Aisha (CSM): thanks. any correlation with p50/p95 latency or errors during that spike?
Tom (Data Eng): p50 steady ~110ms, p95 jumped from 360ms -> 720ms during spike window. error rate baseline 0.09% -> 0.85% at peak (mostly 503/timeout from model replica).
Priya (Solutions Eng): likely backpressure on a small pool — customer still on dedicated small (2xA100). can mitigate with temporary autoscale or burst nodes, or enable smarter batching + longer max_batch_delay.
Leo (AE): customer asked about cost — spend last 7d = $3.7k, WoW +22%. if we autoscale they'll worry. need a cost vs latency plan for renewal convo.
Aisha (CSM): can we produce a 2-slide summary with recommended mitigations and estimated delta in weekly spend?
Tom (Data Eng): quick numbers: enabling batching (batch_size cap 64) + prefix cache for common prompts -> estimated token cost reduction 12-18%, p95 projected down to ~420ms. autoscale to 4 GPUs during peaks would add ~$650/wk on their commit.
Priya (Solutions Eng): alternative: quantized variant of their model (8-bit) reduces GPU memory + allows denser packing; performance tradeoff small in QA tests. effort = 1 day to validate, and a canary rollout across 10% traffic.
MetricBot: [automated snapshot] 7d token: 20,300,000; avg RPS 18.4; p50 112ms; p95 412ms; errors 0.21% (24h peak 0.85%). link: https://metrics.redwood/bridgepay/7d
Jon (CS Lead): flagged renewal risk = medium because spend uptick + latency spikes. recommend we: (1) run Priya's validation by Wed, (2) schedule a 30m ops review with BridgePay to propose burst plan, (3) prepare cost delta slide for renewal owner (Leo).
Leo (AE): confirmed — I'll own the renewal slide. want the cost + perf tradeoffs by EOD Wed.
Aisha (CSM): I'll set the ops review with BridgePay for Thu 10am PT. Tom / Priya please send numbers & short notes to me before noon Wed.
Tom (Data Eng): putting raw query + query window in #eng-telemetry — will DM Aisha the dataset link.
Priya (Solutions Eng): will run 8-bit validation on a 10% canary and share results by Wed noon. quick note: recommend prefix cache policy for top-15 prompt templates.
Aisha (CSM): perfect. action items: Tom -> telemetry link, Priya -> canary validation, Leo -> renewal slide, Aisha -> ops meeting + customer pre-brief. tagging for visibility: @Jon (CS Lead) @Leo (AE) @Priya (Solutions Eng).
Leo (AE): :thumbsup:
Aisha (CSM): prepping a single-slide TL;DR for the customer: 1) observed WoW spike driving p95 errors 2) short-term: burst + batching 3) medium-term: quantized canary -> cost down. will circulate draft here.
MetricBot: note: next automated rollover report scheduled in 48h.
Aisha (CSM): closing thread — will post slides once ready. anything else?
Jon (CS Lead): no, looks good. defer to the meeting for deeper root cause.
